title: Auth — Signing Key Revoke — payload
description: Revoke one signing-key delegation, by its key. The next document the key signs is refused. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: Auth — Signing Key Revoke — response payload

revokedAt.description: When the delegation was revoked. For a delegation that was already revoked, the original instant: a revoke of a revoked key succeeds and changes nothing.

remainingActive.description: How many of the owning identity's delegations are still active. Zero is a legitimate state: losing every delegated key costs an identity the delegated signing path, not its own standing or its other credentials.
